item.title: Tsundere Shoujo wa Oshiete Hoshii
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Twinkle STARs
  • 発売日: 2023-12-08
  • スコア: 6.0/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ツンデレ少女は教えてほしいっ
  • 英語名: Tsundere Shoujo wa Oshiete Hoshii

あらすじ

You work as a private tutor.

I don’t know if it’s because there’s a shortage of staff or because of the good reputation, but this time I was assigned to be a private tutor for one child.

On a hot summer day, I headed to a room in an apartment and was greeted by a blonde girl named “Ayano”.

item.title: Yuru Fuwa Shoujo wa Oshiete Hoshii
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Twinkle STARs
  • 発売日: 2023-07-07
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゆるふわ少女は教えてほしいっ
  • 英語名: Yuru Fuwa Shoujo wa Oshiete Hoshii

あらすじ

You are a private tutor.

I have been teaching only small students so far, but suddenly I became responsible for the entrance exam students.

I have to make sure they acquire the academic ability to pass the exam by the deadline…?

The sudden start of a weekend home tutor life with my student, Kanon-chan.Kanon-chan seems to have a strong interest in sex, and she doesn’t seem to mind the sexual harassment that happens casually.
